interface.longDescription: Release v0.23.0: opt-in tool-call failure diagnostics with complete receipts, a render-matched temporal control arm, Hangul syllable-bigram BM25 ranking, and warning-only fabrication-candidate and ledger source-support checks, plus an advisory CI supply-chain audit. Published as a GitHub immutable release with LF SHA256SUMS. Default outputs are unchanged; the observed local model still fails both Korean tool tasks. Existing memory, diagnostics, provenance, budgets and Jarvis API-auth boundary remain. No default network/model call or automatic vault migration.
